graph.baseline: committed portable + no-AB12 FFN + native FA4

method.process_scope: each environment value was set before CUDA initialization in a fresh process
method.interpretation: short diagnostic only; differences below normal run-to-run noise are not performance claims

launch_queue_scale.result: default, 2x, and 4x are indistinguishable; enlarging the pending command buffer does not improve B29/S2

hyper_q_connections.result: one connection regresses, two restores most throughput, and the default eight is already sufficient; sixteen adds no benefit

decision.reason: The default queue capacity and eight Hyper-Q connections already saturate this two-stream workload. Larger values do not create additional ready grids or improve throughput.
